summary: A detailed, phased implementation plan for expanding the Genomic Research Copilot into a Precision Cancer Cure OS. Covers 4 phases over 18 months: Phase 1 (Somatic Cancer Foundation), Phase 2 (OncoCRISPR Designer), Phase 3 (OncoViral Therapy Planner), and Phase 4 (Advanced Cancer AI Features). Every phase includes backend modules, database schemas, API endpoints, frontend components, and compliance additions — all grounded in the actual codebase reviewed.
